ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two TTL three-state output logic blocks in the figure, and their output terminals are connected in parallel to the same node F. The upper logic block is marked internally with “&”, and its data inputs come from A and B; its EN enable terminal has a small circle, indicating low-active enable, and the control signal is C. The input of the lower logic block comes from B, and its output terminal has a small circle, indicating output inversion; its EN enable terminal has no small circle, indicating high-active enable, and the control signal is C. Reasoning: When C=0, the upper three-state gate is enabled, and the output is the AND of A and B, namely AB, so its contribution to F is AB\overline{C}. When C=1, the lower three-state gate is enabled, and because there is an inversion bubble at the output terminal, the output is \overline{B}, so its contribution to F is \overline{B}C. The two three-state outputs share node F under complementary enable conditions, so adding the two valid outputs gives F=AB\overline{C}+\overline{B}C.

raw_record.question_text: Based on the figure, what is the Boolean expression for the TTL logic gate output \(F\)?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: two TTL tri-state blocks have their outputs connected together at F. The top block is an AND gate receiving A and B and is enabled when C=0 because its EN input has a bubble. Its contribution is AB\overline{C}. The bottom block is enabled when C=1 and outputs the inverted value of B because of the output bubble, giving \overline{B}C. Since the two tri-state outputs share the F node and are enabled in complementary cases, OR the two enabled contributions to obtain F=AB\overline{C}+\overline{B}C.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个TTL三态输出逻辑块，它们的输出端并接到同一个节点F。上方逻辑块内部标有“&”，其数据输入来自A和B；它的EN使能端带有小圆圈，表示低有效使能，控制信号为C。下方逻辑块的输入来自B，输出端带有小圆圈，表示输出取反；它的EN使能端无小圆圈，表示高有效使能，控制信号为C。推理：当C=0时，上方三态门被使能，输出为A与B的与，即AB，因此对F的贡献为AB\overline{C}。当C=1时，下方三态门被使能，并且由于输出端有反相泡，输出为\overline{B}，因此对F的贡献为\overline{B}C。两个三态输出在互补使能条件下共用F节点，所以将两个有效输出相加得到F=AB\overline{C}+\overline{B}C。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use tri-state TTL bus behavior: only the enabled block drives the common output, so the output is the sum of each block’s logic value gated by its enable condition. An EN bubble means active-low enable; an output bubble means inversion.
